audit: Independent Re-Closure Audit - Milestone 2 Second Critical Repairs (M2_SECOND_REPAIR_CLOSURE_REFUSED)
ending_commit_note: The ending commit is the single intentional commit 'fix: close paired runner M2 live-workspace and runtime races' created on this branch; its hash is reported in the terminal response and cannot appear inside the object it commits.

findings.closure: Every run_command effect materialises a private per-effect copy before STARTED, binds it with bwrap --bind-fd, and after quiescence exports only a closed regular-file/directory/symlink change set. Host FIFOs/sockets created in the authorized workspace are invisible to the effect; source mutation or unsupported private inodes refuse export.
findings.reproduction: With a live writable workspace bind, a host creates late.fifo after admission; the effect opens it and exchanges bytes. Seccomp does not filter open/openat by inode type.
findings.title: A host can create a FIFO after admission and communicate with the running effect

findings.closure: Launcher is created stopped when a cgroup subtree exists, attached, membership-verified from cgroup.procs, then released. Attachment failure refuses before exec. active means membership verified. Promised CGROUP_V2_AND_RLIMIT cannot silently degrade. Cleanup with live members is not success.
findings.reproduction: EffectCgroup.attach return value was ignored; mechanism was derived from directory existence (cgroup.active), not cgroup.procs membership.
findings.title: Cgroup enforcement can be falsely reported

findings.closure: BoundRuntime opens and verifies launcher/interpreter/init/private-view descriptors at the effect boundary; launcher executes as /proc/self/fd/N; interpreter and init mount via --ro-bind-fd; private view via --bind-fd. Replacement after bind cannot redirect the executed or mounted inode.
findings.reproduction: Manifest hashed pathnames; later Popen and mounts reused those pathnames, leaving a same-owner replacement window.
findings.title: Capsule runtime identity remains vulnerable to pathname replacement after recheck

findings.closure: M2_VALIDATION_REPORT.json is regenerated from live unittest discovery with per-module counts, pass/fail/error/skip, platform classification, soak fingerprint, and discovered_total equal to total.
findings.reproduction: Independent discovery found 305 tests; M2_VALIDATION_REPORT.json recorded total 229 and omitted the second-repair module.
findings.title: Validation evidence reports the wrong test total

modification_rationale: The Milestone 2 second-repair commit did not pass independent re-closure. Findings M2-B21, M2-M22, M2-M23, and M2-M24 are closed here and only here. Milestone 3 was not begun.

withdrawn_claims.claim: A live writable host workspace bind plus preflight special-inode scan plus seccomp denial of endpoint creation closes host IPC.
withdrawn_claims.reason: A host can create a FIFO after admission; open of that FIFO is not filtered by the seccomp program.
withdrawn_claims.replaced_by: Private per-effect execution view bound by descriptor, with trusted closed-grammar export after quiescence.

withdrawn_claims.claim: cgroup.active / directory existence proves aggregate cgroup enforcement.
withdrawn_claims.reason: attach() failures were ignored; membership was never read back from cgroup.procs.
withdrawn_claims.replaced_by: Stopped launch, attach, verify membership, then release; refuse on failure.

withdrawn_claims.claim: Hashing a pathname and later executing that pathname binds runtime identity.
withdrawn_claims.reason: Same-owner replacement between recheck and Popen/mount redirects the kernel object while evidence keeps the old digest.
withdrawn_claims.replaced_by: Descriptor-bound launch and mounts through /proc/self/fd/N and --ro-bind-fd/--bind-fd.
